summary: Use measurements at a contact to distinguish touch, deformation and slip before closing a manipulation loop.
outcomes: Connect tactile measurements to calibrated contact-state estimates
Evaluate slip detection under material and lighting or sensor variation
sequence: Compare force/torque and spatial tactile observations
Track deformation and candidate slip cues
Separate actual slip from sensor artefacts
Evaluate detection latency and false alarms in a feedback scenario

visual.question: Does a changing tactile image indicate slip or changing normal force?
visual.interaction: Vary tangential motion and normal load independently on recorded or synthetic data

practice.task: Analyze a small tactile slip-detection fixture
practice.success: Ground-truth definition, calibration, latency and error cases are reported without conflating contact changes
